name: Minnesota United FC
notes: Replaces the earlier record's Wikipedia capacity source. Forbes is cited through the Internet Archive snapshot of its February 2026 MLS list because forbes.com article pages refuse automated fetches, and Minnesota is not on Forbes' May 2026 world soccer list, so it has no forbes.com/teams page. Revenue and operating income (EBITDA) are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season. Sportico's February 2026 dataset values the club at $655m with $71m revenue. Founded year is the original NSC Minnesota Stars (2010); McGuire took over in November 2012, the club was rebranded Minnesota United FC in 2013, was awarded the MLS franchise on 25 March 2015 and began MLS play in 2017. The owner list is Sports Business Journal's April 2019 list of the majority of the then 16-person group: no later full list or stake percentages were found, and Business Journal coverage of December 2016 additions could not be read. The Pohlads and Glen Taylor were named in the March 2015 award (SBJ says they came on board with the 2016 MLS move), so their since_year is left blank. Allianz Field opened in 2019; the stadium's own site says it was 100% privately funded. Shari Ballard, CEO for five years, retires after the 2026 season; former Target executive Christina Hennington was named CEO on 14 July 2026. The NASL-era club won the 2011 NASL championship; no MLS Cup. Not found on a citable page: registered legal entity, average attendance, social-media follower counts, any ownership transaction after 2017.

ownership_summary: Minnesota United is owned by a group of Minnesota families and business people led by managing partner Dr. Bill McGuire, who bought the club's NASL predecessor in November 2012. The group, put at 16 people in 2019, includes former Timberwolves owner Glen Taylor, the Twins-owning Pohlad family, Wendy Carlson Nelson, the Mortenson and Binger families, Delaware North's Jeremy Jacobs Jr., Matt Mithun, Justin Kelly and Ben Grossman. Individual stakes have never been disclosed, and no fund or institutional investor is reported.
